verdict.rationale: Founder Law's founder work visa page has its own short intake: "Tell us a bit about yourself to start your case assessment," taking only a few minutes. This is a first-party assessment entry point, but the evidence does not say it is free, structured, or self-serve with an immediate eligibility result. It reads more like an intake form that leads to attorney review than an automated O-1/EB-1 qualifier. Missing for 10: confirmation the assessment is free, evidence of structured O-1/EB-1 criteria scoring or self-serve results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site

citations.quote: Tell us a bit about yourself to start your case assessment. It takes only a few minutes.
